name: ComboBreaker
mechanic: Buy in a row to build a combo and pay less. The big sell that breaks the streak pays its buyers.
plain: A streak game for ETH pools. Back-to-back buys grow a combo, and each buy in the streak pays a smaller fee (0.30% down to 0.04%). A sell big enough to break the streak pays a breaker fee that grows with the combo (up to 5%), and the streak's whole pot is split among its buyers by how much ETH they bought. A buy only shares the pot once it is 10 minutes old; a newer buy just gets its own fee back. Smaller sells chip in 0.30% and keep the streak alive. A streak with no buys for 24 hours closes on its own.
rules: A buy of at least MIN_BUY adds 1 to the combo and pays 0.30% minus 0.02% per combo step, down to 0.04%.
A sell of at least max(MIN_BREAK, 10% of the streak's volume) breaks the streak and pays 0.30% plus 0.10% per combo step, up to 5%.
Smaller sells and buys pay 0.30% into the pot and leave the combo alone.
At close the pot is split by ETH bought; a buy counts only once 10 minutes old, and newer buys get their own fee back.
A streak can break only after its first buy is 10 minutes old; with no buy for 24 hours it closes with no breaker fee.

fee.note: 0.04%-0.30% on buys, up to 5% on the breaking sell, all into the pot
